category: SwiGLU gated FFN block (3 matmuls + SiLU gate + product, composition)
edge_cases: SwiGLU: gate=X.Wg, up=X.Wu (two HMX projections), H=SiLU(gate)*up (SiLU LUT gate + elementwise product on HVX), out=H.Wd (HMX down projection) -- three matmuls, one gated product
SiLU applied to the GATE branch only (not up); nearmiss_no_silu multiplies the raw linear gate by up (drops SiLU) and must fail
SiLU is a hardswish approximation supplied as a runtime uint8 LUT (index g+128) so the nonlinearity is bit-exact by definition (no libm, no tolerance)

gate matmul X[64x64].Wg[64x128] and up matmul X[64x64].Wu[64x128] -> H[64x128]; down matmul H[64x128].Wd[128x64] -> out[64x64]; gate/up are 2x4 grids of 32x32 tiles (2 K-tiles), down is a 2x2 grid (4 K-tiles), one mxclracc per output tile

gated intermediate H staged VTCM-resident between the up/gate matmuls and the down matmul (bulk 128B vector copy in, bulk copy back out for down-matmul activation packing) alongside the HMX crouton operand slots -- hmx+hvx+vtcm = 3 mechanism groups

down-proj activation carries an int8 zero-point of 8 (h in [-8,7] -> Hu in [0,15], unsigned for the HMX activation.ub load); Wd columns are constructed to sum to ZERO so the zero-point contributes no per-column offset and out_acc equals the true gated.Wd
input ranges + zero-sum Wd keep |gate/up field|<=612 and |down field|<=1088 (all < 2048) so every HMX 12-bit requant field is exact and the whole block is bit-exact
crouton pack/unpack staged through cacheable buffers, moved to/from VTCM in bulk 128B vector copies (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc would lose)
harness reference computed via three HVX vrmpy matmuls, cross-checked against an INDEPENDENT full scalar SwiGLU golden on row 0 (all three matmuls + gate)
S,D,Dff are 32-multiples (crouton requirement); Dff=128 so the down reduction is one whole vrmpy vector
name: i8_ffn_swiglu_block

params.silu: hardswish approximation, runtime LUT (256 entries, index g+128)

signal: SwiGLU gated FFN block (3 matmuls + SiLU gate + elementwise product)
